name: Average Order Value

FROM zs_observe.ajio_oms

name: Cancellation Rate

  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS cancel_rate
FROM zs_observe.ajio_oms WHERE is_active = true

name: Cancellation Rate

sql_pattern:

  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER(), 1) AS pct

name: Count Credit Notes by Month

sql_pattern:

name: Credit Note → Reverse Matching
parser_note: Preserve SQL exactly; parser may normalize schema aliases separately.
sql_pattern:
SELECT c.invoice_number AS credit_note, c.purchase_po_no,
  r.order_id AS return_id, r.transaction_type, r.charged_amount
FROM zs_observe.ajio_credit_note c
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.ajio_reverse r
  ON c.purchase_po_no = r.purchase_po_no AND r.is_active = true
WHERE c.is_active = true

intent: Join Credit Note to Original Order
name: Join Credit Note to Original Order
natural_language_patterns: Join Credit Note to Original Order
join credit note to original order
parser_note: Preserve SQL exactly; parser may normalize schema aliases separately.
sql_pattern:
SELECT c.invoice_number AS credit_note, c.created_date AS cn_date,
  o.order_id, o.charged_amount, o.description, o.brand
FROM zs_observe.ajio_credit_note c
JOIN zs_observe.ajio_oms o ON c.purchase_po_no = o.purchase_po_no
WHERE c.is_active = true AND o.is_active = true

name: Join Returns to Original Orders
parser_note: Preserve SQL exactly; parser may normalize schema aliases separately.
sql_pattern:
SELECT r.order_id AS return_id, r.parent_id AS original_order,
  r.transaction_type, r.charged_amount AS return_charged,
  o.charged_amount AS original_charged, o.description, o.brand
FROM zs_observe.ajio_reverse r
JOIN zs_observe.ajio_oms o ON r.parent_id = o.order_id
WHERE r.is_active = true AND o.is_active = true

name: Monthly Sales with AOV
parser_note: Preserve SQL exactly; parser may normalize schema aliases separately.
sql_pattern:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(charged_amount) AS gross_sales,
  AVG(charged_amount) AS aov
FROM zs_observe.ajio_oms
WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'Delivered'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

intent: Find delivered OMS orders without a settlement record using purchase_po_no as primary key.
name: OMS → Settlement Matching (Unsettled Orders)
parser_note: Preserve SQL exactly; parser may normalize schema aliases separately.
sql_pattern:
SELECT o.order_id, o.purchase_po_no, o.charged_amount, o.created_date, o.order_status
FROM zs_observe.ajio_oms o
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.ajio_settlement s
  ON o.purchase_po_no = s.purchase_po_no AND s.is_active = true
WHERE o.is_active = true
  AND o.order_status = 'Delivered'
  AND s.purchase_po_no IS NULL

business_warning: B2B premium is an AJIO B2B2C pricing difference, not a standard commission/fee waterfall.
name: OMS vs Settlement Amount Comparison
parser_note: Preserve SQL exactly; parser may normalize schema aliases separately.
sql_pattern:
SELECT o.order_id, o.purchase_po_no,
  o.charged_amount AS customer_price,
  s.charged_amount AS settlement_price,
  s.charged_amount - o.charged_amount AS b2b_premium
FROM zs_observe.ajio_oms o
JOIN zs_observe.ajio_settlement s
  ON o.purchase_po_no = s.purchase_po_no
WHERE o.is_active = true
  AND s.is_active = true
  AND o.order_status = 'Delivered'
LIMIT 20

name: Return Rate
parser_note: Preserve SQL exactly; parser may normalize schema aliases separately.
sql_pattern:
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.parent_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 1) AS return_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.ajio_oms o
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.ajio_reverse r ON o.order_id = r.parent_id AND r.is_active = true
WHERE o.is_active = true AND o.order_status = 'Delivered'

name: Return Rate (vs OMS Forward Orders)
parser_note: Preserve SQL exactly; parser may normalize schema aliases separately.
sql_pattern:
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * r.cnt / o.cnt, 1) AS return_rate_pct
FROM
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT parent_id) AS cnt FROM zs_observe.ajio_reverse WHERE is_active = true) r,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS cnt FROM zs_observe.ajio_oms WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'Delivered') o

FROM zs_observe.ajio_settlement
WHERE is_active = true AND payment_status = 'PAID'

business_warning: B2B premium is an AJIO B2B2C pricing difference, not a standard commission/fee waterfall.
name: Settlement vs OMS Revenue Comparison
parser_note: Preserve SQL exactly; parser may normalize schema aliases separately.
sql_pattern:
SELECT
  SUM(s.charged_amount) AS settlement_value,
  SUM(o.charged_amount) AS oms_customer_value,
  SUM(s.charged_amount) - SUM(o.charged_amount) AS b2b_premium
FROM zs_observe.ajio_settlement s
JOIN zs_observe.ajio_oms o
  ON s.purchase_po_no = o.purchase_po_no
WHERE s.is_active = true
  AND o.is_active = true
  AND s.payment_status = 'PAID'
